counting.tools: Selected trajectory, deduplicated by tool_call_id per trial; observation joined by call ID.
counting.process: An exec launch requires a running-session response. A poll must refer to the same process within the trial. Child agents are not counted here.
counting.compactions: Selected native session records; post-checkpoint calls end at the next checkpoint or end of the same trace. No prompt text or tool output is exported.
counting.scores: Strict pass and core API check counts are copied from the existing published trial and replay views. No regrading.
